tei:div.tei:p: 371) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rje btsun 'phags ma'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs dpal ster bzhugs: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye:

rim gnyis lam 'jug rnal 'byor pas: sgo gsum mi phyed dad gus kyis: gsol 'debs rim pa 'di ltar bya: e ma hoḥ chos sku snang mtha' longs sku spyan ras gzigs: sprul sku rigs gsum 'gro mgon pad+ma 'byung: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: byin rlabs ye shes dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ye shes mtsho rgyal nam snying zhi ba mtsho: bka' babs don brgyud bla mar gsol= byin rlabs ye shes= dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las gcig bsdus dpal: dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rje btsun ma: 'phags ma sgrol ma nyer gcig lha mor bcasaḥ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la: gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol: rim gnyis grub 'bras mngon du gyur pa dang: byin rlabs ye shes= yongs grub gdan gsum bkod pa'i gzhal yas nas: zhi ba rdor dbyings 'bar ba khrag 'thung tshogs: rtsa gsum dpa' bo 372)mkha' 'gro dam can la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: byin rlabs ye shes= bskyed rim rnam dag snod bcud lha skur dag: rdzogs rim rtsa rlung thig le bcud du smin: rig pa mi 'gyur srid zhi mnyam nyid rdzogs: tshe 'dir 'chi ba'i lam la mi ltos par: zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sa thob shog: zhes pa mos gus kyis bskul nas: gsol 'debs 'di la brtson gyur na: rim gnyis lam mchog mngon gyur nas: don gnyis rim gyis 'byung bar nges: the tshom med do sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ces pa 'di yang bo dha dang nyi ma sgron ma'i bzhed skong du ser dgon dben gnas mtshams khrod dga' ba'i ljongs nas bde ba'i rdo rjes yig med mkha' 'gro'i brda las zhal bshus pa'i yi ge pa ni bu chung dge btsun shī la badz+ra gyis bgyis pa'o// maṅga lam//
